title: Gate footing: idealised model
subtitle: Parametric CAD rebuild of the Polycam scan · real size · Z-up · millimetres
scale_note: Built at your measurements: 100 mm long, 15 mm slot. Type another length to preview a different size.
notes: Now at real size. Everything is scaled from your 100 mm length, and the slot is set to your 15 mm measurement (the scan alone suggested 15.9 mm). The shape is unchanged from the last review: flat parallel slot walls, a 15° draft on the outer faces, and rounded edges throughout. It is 0.6 mm from the scan on average. It fits the A1 easily and prints base-down with no supports.
